title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
title_zh: SceneRig：从单张图像生成仿真级3D场景的智能体系统

paragraphs.en: 总结：SceneRig是一个智能体系统，可将单张图像重建为可编辑、物理稳定且适用于机器人仿真环境的3D场景。 Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：SceneRig是一个智能体系统，可将单张图像重建为可编辑、物理稳定且适用于机器人仿真环境的3D场景。仿真是机器人学的重要工具，但大规模构建多样化、可直接用于仿真的场景仍然困难。 从单张图像重建场景是一种有前景的替代方案，但仅有视觉上的相似是不够的：物体还必须被完整恢复、准确定位，并在物理上落地。 现有依赖事后物理沉降的方法常常导致物体错位，产生的场景看起来正确，但在操作交互中表现不佳。 我们提出SceneRig，一个将单张图像转化为可编辑、可直接用于仿真的场景的智能体系统。 SceneRig结合几何、视觉和物理工具来重建忠实的3D场景。 随后，智能体在物理仿真器中执行「编辑—验证」循环以实现物理稳定。 在多样化的输入上，SceneRig提升了实例分割、以物体为中心的外观以及3D定位效果，同时保持重建场景的物理稳定性。 此外，SceneRig对下游机器人任务同样有效：其场景能够比基线方法更准确地预测真实机器人策略的结果，并在无需轨迹适配的情况下更可靠地支持对已录制操作的回放。
